name: peoplesoft-studio

peoplesoft.writeNamePrefix.description: Limits saving and creating definitions to names starting with this prefix (for example ZZ_). Empty: no limit.

peoplesoft.connections.description: Configured PeopleSoft environments. Passwords are stored in the OS secret store, never here.

enumDescriptions: Oracle database
Microsoft SQL Server database
DB2 database (LUW, or z/OS through DB2 Connect)
App Designer project export file

connectString.description: Oracle: an easy-connect string, e.g. host:1521/PSFTDB. SQL Server: host[\instance][:port]/database, e.g. sqlhost:1433/HCM92. DB2: host[:port]/database, e.g. db2host:50000/HCM92 (z/OS: the location name).

schema.description: Schema owning the PeopleTools tables (the owner ID). Empty: read from PS.PSDBOWNER, else the platform default (Oracle SYSADM; SQL Server the login's default schema; DB2 the user's).

path.description: For projectFile: folder containing the App Designer XML export

decoder.description: How this connection renders PeopleCode read from PSPCMPROG. Omit to use peoplesoft.peoplecode.decoder.

peoplecodeAccess.description: Whether PeopleCode may be saved natively to this database. Defaults to read-only. Writable requires peoplesoftOperatorId; for now only ZZ_PCODE_LAB definitions can be saved.

peoplecodeSaveMode.description: What a PeopleCode save writes: 'compile-and-save' writes the source and the compiled program (PSPCMTXT, PSPCMPROG, PSPCMNAME), as App Designer does. 'save-only' is not available (App Designer never stores uncompiled source); saves are refused in that mode.

peoplesoftOperatorId.description: The PeopleSoft operator (PSOPRDEFN.OPRID) PeopleCode saves are recorded as (LASTUPDOPRID). Required for a writable connection; it must exist in that database.

signon.description: Sign-on: twoTier = the database login (user) is the proxy Connect ID and peoplesoftOperatorId is the operator the connection acts as. threeTier = App Designer's 3 Tier (Application Server) sign-on over Tuxedo (appServer* fields); the database is never touched directly. Absent: direct sign-on with the database login.

appServerMachine.description: 3 Tier: the application server machine name or IP address.

tuxedoConnectString.description: 3 Tier: the Tuxedo connect string (//host:port), when used instead of machine/port.

walletLocation.description: 3 Tier: Oracle Wallet location, when the domain connection uses one.

walletName.description: 3 Tier: Oracle Wallet name, when the domain connection uses one.

appServerPort.description: 3 Tier: the application server listener port.

peoplesoft.oracle.thickModeLibDir.description: Path to Oracle Instant Client. Leave empty to use node-oracledb Thin mode.

peoplesoft.db2.driverPath.description: Directory holding an ibm_db installation (node_modules/ibm_db) for DB2 connections. Leave empty to use the one PeopleSoft: Install DB2 Driver installs.

peoplesoft.peoplecode.decoder.description: Default PeopleCode decoder for connections that do not set their own (peoplesoft.connections[].decoder). 'raw' dumps the token stream for decoder development.

peoplesoft.mcp.enabled.description: Run the local PeopleSoft Studio MCP server, which gives AI clients access to connected PeopleSoft environments: read, and write as peoplesoft.mcp.writes allows. Turning it off stops the server.

peoplesoft.mcp.port.description: Port the MCP server listens on (always 127.0.0.1). A running server restarts on the new port; reconfigure AI clients that use the old URL.

enumDescriptions: VS Code shows what the agent wants to save; nothing is written until you approve it.
Writes go straight through (still only on Writable connections with an Operator ID, within the write scope).
The MCP is read-only.
peoplesoft.mcp.writes.description: Whether AI clients may save PeopleSoft definitions through the MCP server (PeopleCode, SQL, HTML, style sheets, pages, records, fields, translates, projects, packages, Integration Broker).

peoplesoft.sql.maxRows.markdownDescription: The most rows *Run SQL* shows. A query runs read only and is always rolled back: one SELECT, no `INTO` or `FOR UPDATE`; `%Table(record)` is the only meta-SQL expanded.

peoplesoft.peoplecode.languageServer.ena.description: PeopleCode language features: completion, hover, signature help, Go to Definition, Find References, the outline and validation as you type. Off: PeopleCode editors are plain text with highlighting; Validate PeopleCode still runs on demand.

peoplesoft.peoplecode.validateAsYouType.description: Compile the PeopleCode in the editor with PeopleSoft Studio's compiler a moment after you stop typing, and show where it stops in Problems (Validate PeopleCode, as you type). Large programs compile on a background thread. Application Designer has the last word. Needs peoplesoft.peoplecode.languageServer.enabled.

peoplesoft.peoplecode.validationDelay.description: Milliseconds typing must pause before validation as you type compiles the program.

peoplesoft.peoplecode.checkEnvironment.description: Check RECORD.FIELD references against the connection's records, as Validate Syntax does ("Field REC.FIELD not defined. (2,17)"), and offer to qualify bare field names with the program's record as Application Designer stores them. Reads record definitions from the database.

peoplesoft.peoplecode.unknownFunctionWar.description: Warn about a call to a function that is neither a PeopleCode built-in nor declared in the program ("Unknown function. (2,15)").

enumDescriptions: Recreate table if it already exists (drops its data)
Skip table if it already exists
peoplesoft.build.create.table.description: Build Settings, Create: when the table already exists.

enumDescriptions: Recreate view if it already exists
Skip view if it already exists
peoplesoft.build.create.view.description: Build Settings, Create: when the view already exists.

enumDescriptions: Recreate index if it already exists
Recreate index only if modified
peoplesoft.build.create.index.description: Build Settings, Create: when the index already exists.

enumDescriptions: Recreate sequence if it already exists
Alter sequence only if modified
peoplesoft.build.create.sequence.description: Build Settings, Create: when the sequence already exists.

enumDescriptions: Drop column if data present
Skip record if data present
peoplesoft.build.alter.dropColumn.description: Build Settings, Alter: when a dropped column holds data.

enumDescriptions: Truncate data if field too short
Skip record if field too short
peoplesoft.build.alter.changeLength.description: Build Settings, Alter: when data is longer than a shortened field.

peoplesoft.projects.includeMenus.description: Project Contents: when an AI agent adds definitions to a project, include menus. Off: menus are still created, but left out of projects.

peoplesoft.projects.includePortalRegistr.description: Project Contents: include Portal Registry structures (content references and folders) in projects. Off: they are still created, but left out of projects.

peoplesoft.projects.includeSecurity.description: Project Contents: include permission lists and roles in projects. Off: they are still created, but left out of projects.

peoplesoft.build.alter.evenIfNoChanges.description: Build Settings, Alter: alter even if no changes.

enumDescriptions: Alter in Place
Alter by Table Rename
peoplesoft.build.alter.tableOption.description: Build Settings, Alter: how a table is altered.

peoplesoft.build.alter.inMemory.description: Build Settings, Alter: Alter Table In Memory.

peoplesoft.customization.namingPrefixes.markdownDescription: The naming prefixes and who owns definitions named with them: the organization's own prefix, and each bolt-on vendor's (bolt-ons carry their own prefixes). An `organization` prefix is evidence that a definition is the organization's (Custom), a `partner` prefix that it is a vendor's (Partner). New definitions are suggested the first organization prefix. Supporting evidence only: a prefix never decides ownership on its own. See docs/CUSTOMIZATION.md. While the list is empty, the write-scope prefix (`peoplesoft.writeNamePrefix`) counts as the organization's.

enumDescriptions: The organization's own definitions.
A bolt-on vendor's definitions.

name.description: The organization or vendor (shown in the evidence).

peoplesoft.customization.organizationPre.patternErrorMessage: A prefix such as ZZ_: a letter, letters or digits, then an underscore.
peoplesoft.customization.organizationPre.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `peoplesoft.customization.namingPrefixes`; this single prefix is read only while that list is empty.

enumDescriptions: Prefer configuration frameworks and custom definitions over changing delivered definitions.
Allow direct modification of delivered definitions where the delivered-object policy permits.
peoplesoft.customization.defaultStrategy.description: The customization strategy the Customization Strategy view and plans prefer (a preference, not yet enforced).

enumDescriptions: Refuse every edit of a delivered definition.
Edits of delivered definitions need an explicit approval.
Allow edits of delivered definitions, recording each.
peoplesoft.customization.deliveredObject.description: Your saves, renames and deletes, in the editors and designers, of an Oracle- or vendor-delivered definition or one of unknown ownership. allowWithAudit (the default) writes and records each in the audit log; requireApproval asks; block refuses (unknown ownership is asked, never refused). New definitions are not affected. AI agents have their own: agentDeliveredObjectPolicy.

enumDescriptions: Refuse every agent write to a delivered definition (unknown ownership is asked, never refused).
Ask you in VS Code for each agent write to a delivered definition -- even when MCP writes are "allow".
Allow agent writes to delivered definitions, recording each.
peoplesoft.customization.agentDeliveredO.description: The same writes made by an AI agent through the MCP. requireApproval (the default) asks you in VS Code for each, even when peoplesoft.mcp.writes is "allow"; an agent cannot approve them.

peoplesoft.customization.requireImpactAn.description: Preview, not enforced yet. Require an upgrade-impact analysis before a write.

peoplesoft.customization.suggestPrefixFo.description: Preview, not enforced yet. Suggest the organization prefix when naming a new definition.

enumDescriptions: Nothing is sent (default).
You may submit a discovery to the server below; each submission is shown to you, exactly, and sent only when you approve it.
peoplesoft.intelligence.uploadMode.markdownDescription: Whether discoveries may be submitted to a Discovery & Intelligence server (docs/intelligence). VS Code telemetry set to `off` and a machine policy (`/etc/peoplesoft-studio/policy.json`, `%ProgramData%\\PeopleSoftStudio\\policy.json`) override this.

peoplesoft.intelligence.serverUrl.markdownDescription: The discovery server submissions go to (HTTPS; plain HTTP only to this machine). The token is set with *PeopleSoft: Set Discovery Server Token…* and kept in VS Code's secret storage.

enumDescriptions: Never download knowledge (default).
*PeopleSoft: Check for Knowledge Updates* downloads the server's latest bundle; it is installed only if its signature, key, expiry and version verify.
peoplesoft.intelligence.knowledgeSync.markdownDescription: Downloading signed knowledge bundles from the discovery server (`peoplesoft.intelligence.serverUrl`). Bundles are data only: they never change what PeopleSoft Studio or an agent may write.

enumDescriptions: Start Claude Code in a terminal with the request.
Start Codex in a terminal with the request.
Copy the prompt, for any other agent connected to the PeopleSoft Studio MCP server.
peoplesoft.buildRequests.agent.description: The AI agent a Build Request is handed to. The agent must have the PeopleSoft Studio MCP server configured (PeopleSoft: Configure AI Client).
